items.title: MMC1 / SxROM implemented
items.message: Mapper 1 is implemented for headless execution, trace, snapshot, and diagnostics. Family: mmc. Notes: MMC1 shift-register PRG/CHR banking scaffold is implemented for headless KITAQFC tests.

items.title: CHR-RAM cartridge
items.message: CHR-RAM writes are routed through mapper write_chr; pixel-accurate rendering is still later work.

items.title: Battery-backed cartridge
items.message: PRG-RAM state participates in mapper snapshots where supported.

items.title: PPU register writes during visible rendering candidate
items.message: 2 rendering-sensitive PPU register writes occurred while background/sprite rendering was active on visible scanlines (ctrl=0, mask=2, scroll=0, addr=0, data=0).
items.recommendation: Reduce per-frame VRAM/OAM-side work, split queued VRAM writes across frames, or perform bulk updates with rendering disabled.
